theme_strategy: Class-based dark/light toggle. Default to dark mode for kitchen/operations command center aesthetic (modern, sleek, high contrast), while maintaining pristine high-contrast light mode for daytime managerial reporting. Uses rich culinary warm anchors: Deep Crimson Ember (#D94833 / #E64833) as primary action kinetic trigger, Emerald Leaf (#2C614F / #25D366 for WhatsApp trust), and Warm Basmati/Clay accents.

entry_surfaces./login: split branded auth — culinary showcase & WhatsApp AI live simulation panel left, auth credentials card right with quick-switch demo badges for Super Admin and Restaurant Manager
entry_surfaces./: command center dashboard — real-time WhatsApp bot status bar top, high-velocity revenue stat cards, interactive orders pipeline, flagship visual menu quick-glance, recent chat activity feed

visual_enhancers.card_style: 1px crisp border (border-border/60), subtle backdrop blur on elevated cards (backdrop-blur-md bg-card/85), 12px nested radii (rounded-xl), hover lift (-translate-y-0.5 transition-transform duration-200)
visual_enhancers.stat_cards: Bento-style with top accent indicator line (2px crimson or emerald glow), subtle gradient fill (from-primary/10 via-transparent to-transparent), large mono metric, and delta percentage pill badge
visual_enhancers.noise_texture: Subtle 2% SVG noise background to kill flat digital sterility on command center viewports
visual_enhancers.whatsapp_simulation: Realistic emerald header, chat bubbles with audio/text simulation, typing indicator, live parsed food order payload JSON card

accessibility.apca_contrast: All text tokens exceed 4.5:1 on their declared surface. Muted text strictly uses #9BA3AF or lighter on dark (#0D1111) and #475569 on light (#F8F9FA).
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive buttons, filter chips, tabs, inputs, modals, and switches MUST have kebab-case role-based data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='menu-add-dish-btn', data-testid='order-status-select', data-testid='dish-availability-switch-1').
accessibility.currency_accessibility: Always render 'PKR' or 'Rs.' prefix with accessible aria-label (e.g. aria-label='1450 Pakistani Rupees').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Keep existing Vite + React 19 + Tailwind v4 + FastAPI architecture in tact.
2. Upgrade CSS theme variables in frontend/src/index.css to implement the deep charcoal command center palette with #D94833 crimson and #2C614F / #25D366 WhatsApp green accents.

3. Transform the Menu Management page into a flagship experience: add Category management pill list, Grid/Table view toggles, image previews, AI-WhatsApp availability toggles, modifier options (Spicy, Portion sizes), and Pakistani Rupee (PKR) price formatting.
4. Elevate the Restaurant Dashboard with real-time aesthetic widgets (WhatsApp Live Status badge, Pakistani peak ordering hours chart, top revenue dishes, quick action order pipeline).
5. Super Admin panel should look distinctly like a sleek executive SaaS command center with tenant management, subscription tiers in PKR, and billing metrics.
6. Ensure every interactive element has a data-testid attribute for reliable automated testing.

never_use: Full transparent dropdown menus or popovers
Unstyled raw HTML datepicker or select elements (always use custom Shadcn)
Universal 'transition: all' which causes jittery layout recalculations
always_do: Use crisp 1px borders with opacity-controlled contrast (border-border/60)
Provide immediate optimistic UI or sonner toast notifications for user actions
Keep PKR currency symbol and thousands separators clean (e.g., Rs. 2,500)
Test both Dark Mode and Light Mode states
